releases.name: 3.0.0: one entry point, one reference
releases.notes:
## Install

Minimal package: `opencode-go-model-picker-3.0.0-min.zip` contains only what the skill runs — `SKILL.md`, `references/` (one doc plus two dated seeds), `scripts/` (one entry point + modules) and `LICENSE`. Unzip it into `~/.config/opencode/skills/` so the folder is named `opencode-go-model-picker`. Verify with `node scripts/go.mjs --help` (four verbs: `run` / `report` / `check` / `apply`).

Full notes: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) · 中文：[CHANGELOG-ZH.md](https://github.com/sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker/blob/main/zh/CHANGELOG-ZH.md)

## [3.0.0] - 2026-11-01

### The size of the simplification

3.0.0 is not a feature release: it is the same job described with **an order of
magnitude less text**. Measured against the 2.0.0 tag:

| What the model must read | 2.0.0 | 3.0.0 | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Markdown files | 7 (`SKILL.md` + 6 references) | 2 (`SKILL.md` + `plan-facts.md`) | −5 files |
| Characters | 104,181 | 8,291 | **12.6× smaller** (−92%) |
| Lines | 1,776 | 168 | **10.6× fewer** (−91%) |
| Estimated tokens | ≈27,400 | ≈2,200 | **≈25,200 saved per full read** |
| `SKILL.md` alone | 18,804 chars ≈4,900 tok | 4,221 chars ≈1,100 tok | −78% |
| Runnable entry points | 9 runtime scripts (11 with maintainer tools) | 1 (`go.mjs`) | −8 runtime |
| Minimal install zip | 128,802 B | 89,163 B | −3…

releases.name: v1.2.0
releases.notes:
# v1.2.0

`skill_management` gives every installed OpenCode skill a switch: list what is installed, find out
why one will not load, hide it from the model, and put it back. Disabling writes **one** global
`skill` permission rule — no skill file is ever moved, edited or deleted.

**No breaking changes in 1.2.0.** The four actions, their inputs, the JSON envelope, the written
rule shape, the same-line marker and the single-file layout are unchanged since 1.1.0.

## Fixed since v1.1.0

- **`list` no longer reports "N skills differ across other agents" on every call.**
 `summary.diverged` counted hidden internal agents (`title`, `summary`, …), which carry
 `{*,*,deny}`; on a real machine that made every skill look divergent (33/33) and added a noise
 warning to each `list`. Only **visible** agents are compared now; `inspect.agents[]` still lists
 every agent, so the detail is not lost.
- **Frontmatter booleans no longer contradict each other.** `disable-model-invocation: "false"` is a
 string, and `Boolean("false") === true`, so `inspect` reported it as `true` while `list` reported
 `autoinvoke: false` for the same file. `true/yes/on/1` and `false/no/off/0` (quoted or not) are
 normalized now, and both fields go through the same rule.
- **A failed sidecar write no longer turns a successful config change into an error.** Once the
 config was written and verified, a sidecar write fa…

en.headline: 27 commits across 5 repositories and 2 releases
en.summary: **27 commits** were recorded across five repositories, with no pull requests, issues, or reviews. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`, 16 own commits prepared `v1.2.0` and `v1.2.1`, serializing enable and write operations to avoid concurrent overwrites, restricting `config_unparsable` rejection to the target configuration file, and validating action outputs against `OUTPUT_SCHEMA`. Documentation changes added design-decision and development pages, moved installation guidance toward npm, and added Chinese release notes for `v1.2.0`. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker`, 6 own commits introduced a single entry point with four verbs and one reference, removed two test artifacts, and corrected release measurements; `v3.0.0` packages the skill with `SKILL.md`, `references/`, `scripts/`, and `LICENSE`. The remaining own commits updated `knowledge-ingest` verification guidance in `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` and documented the Google 2 key path in `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 1 own commit added artifact validation to the daily-report workflow, plus 8 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`.

releaseNotes.summary: The release consolidates the skill into one entry point with four verbs and one reference. Its minimal package contains `SKILL.md`, `references/`, `scripts/`, and `LICENSE`, and can be checked with `node scripts/go.mjs --help`.

This release keeps the four actions, JSON envelope, permission-rule shape, and single-file layout unchanged from `v1.1.0`. It fixes `list` so hidden internal agents no longer make every visible skill appear divergent.

zh.headline: 5 个仓库共 27 次提交，发布 2 个版本
zh.summary: 当天在五个仓库记录了 **27 次提交**，没有拉取请求、issue 或评审。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 的 16 次本人提交完成了 `v1.2.0` 和 `v1.2.1` 的准备，将启用与写入操作串行化以避免并发覆盖，把 `config_unparsable` 的硬拒绝限定到目标配置文件，并按 `OUTPUT_SCHEMA` 校验各动作输出。文档更新新增设计决策与开发页面，将安装说明优先转向 npm，并补充 `v1.2.0` 中文发布说明。`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 的 6 次本人提交引入单一入口、四个动词和一份参考文档，删除两个测试产物并修正发布测量值；`v3.0.0` 包含 `SKILL.md`、`references/`、`scripts/` 和 `LICENSE`。其余本人提交为 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 补充 `knowledge-ingest` 最小验证步骤，并为 `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 记录 Google 2 密钥路径。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 有 1 次本人提交为日报工作流增加生成物校验，另有 8 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。

releaseNotes.summary: 该版本将技能整合为单一入口、四个动词和一份参考文档。最小包包含 `SKILL.md`、`references/`、`scripts/` 和 `LICENSE`，可通过 `node scripts/go.mjs --help` 检查。
该版本保持四个动作、JSON 信封、权限规则格式和单文件布局与 `v1.1.0` 一致。它修复了 `list` 的统计逻辑，不再因隐藏的内部代理而把所有可见技能标记为存在差异。
